Nothing is locked by level, it's locked by your skill. You can pick up quests with a recommended level of 40 at level 5, it's up to you whether you can complete them that early or not. You can go to the highest level region at level 5 too.

If you don't like items being level locked, there's a mod on Nexus to disable all item level requirements.

A level based / level restricted area system is pretty good in my opinion, far better than games like Skyrim where everything is just scaled proportionately to yourself, and therefor levels and progress doesn't matter because if you're 5 the boss is 7, but if you're 30 the boss is 33.
